description: Move an amount of a quantity-tracked item's stock from one place or person to another (e.g. 3 packs of printer paper from the storeroom to room 201, or 5 markers to a teacher). Quantity-tracked items only; assign_item moves serialized items. Location and person ids come from search_resources or from check_item_availability's distribution. Returns every stocked level after the move as distribution: { locationId, name, kind: location|person, quantity, available, reserved?, minStock?, isLow? }, the same row shape check_item_availability returns, so isLow shows whether either end is now low (isLow counts AVAILABLE stock: on hand minus what orders reserved). Amounts reserved for orders or exceeding the source location's stock are rejected. When the item has overdue maintenance the call writes nothing and returns { requiresAcknowledgment: true, warnings }; the same call with acknowledgeWarnings: true performs it. Requires the manager role. Not idempotent: a repeated call moves the stock again.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: true performs the call despite the warnings a previous requiresAcknowledgment result named

amount.description: How many units to move (integer, at least 1)

fromLocationId.description: Source location or person resource id (where the stock is now)

itemId.description: Item id (must be a quantity-tracked item)

toLocationId.description: Destination location or person resource id

name: transfer_stock

distribution.description: Every stocked level after the move — the SAME row shape check_item_availability returns

available.description: Freely usable stock: quantity minus reserved, floored at 0. Always present

isLow.description: True when available < minStock. Present only alongside minStock — absent means no threshold is set here, NOT that the level is healthy

locationId.description: Resource id of this place — pass it straight to adjust_stock, set_min_stock or transfer_stock (no search_resources round-trip needed)

locationName.description: DEPRECATED — the same string as `name`, kept only for clients whose tool list froze before the rename

minStock.description: Restock threshold here (absent when none is set)

reserved.description: Of that, promised to active orders (absent when 0)

instruction.description: Which acknowledge flag performs the call

requiresAcknowledgment.description: Present and true when nothing was written because of what this result names; the SAME call with the acknowledge flag named in `instruction` performs it

warnings.description: Overdue maintenance behind a requires-ack round

title: Transfer stock
